title: Junta restriction failure set
statement: Let $n,k,M$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$, and let $ ailure	ext{-parameter}$ lie in $(0,1/2]$. The junta restriction failure set consists of all sample sequences of length equal to the junta restriction sample count for $k$, $M$, and the failure parameter for which selecting $M$ examples matching $z$ from the samples labeled by $f$ returns no batch.
